cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?
